steps.content: A whole glass window shatters, and a rusty metal pipe tumbles in the shards before silence returns to the museum.
Two figures leap through the broken hole and land steadily on the marble floor in the hall.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's really dark in here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What? Are you scared already? It's still not too late for you to run.
Hella picks up her pipe and shakes the shards off, playfully raising an eyebrow at EMP.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hey, who are you looking down at! I was worried you'd feel pressured if I acted too brave, okay?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! Keep telling yourself that.
The two bicker while carefully stepping over the broken stone pillars on the marble floor and the fallen fences, heading toward the center of the exhibition hall.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: What's this? A monster from some third-rate horror movie? Not even toddler will be scared by this...

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Dear visitors, welcome to the <color=#fb9259>sculpture section</color> of the Witching Hour art exhibition...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ah! <size=40>Ah!</size> <size=45>Ah!!!</size>
EMP jumps straight on Hella's back.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Hello there, don't be nervous. I am Enfer, who's in charge of commentary and guidance. I've introduced myself before.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's humiliating that you're scared by this thing... Get off!
Noticing that the voice is coming from her pocket, EMP lets go of Hella and touches the back of her neck, looking embarrassed. She argues loudly.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Who, who's nervous?! I'm just being vigilant, right, vigilant!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft... Look at your wimpy face. Is that also to ease my pressure?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Shut up! You Minos rat!
Hella lets out ridicule without mercy while the navigator continues to speak calmly as if not hearing anything.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: The theme of this section is <color=#fb9259>Breaking the Cocoon</color>. Through expressionism, surrealism, and deconstructionism, I intend to tear the self-bound cocoon and expose the bloody reality to force people to face their deepest fear of harm.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Please be careful and keep your belongings safe, as there are a large flow of visitors here currently. Finally, I wish you a pleasant and meaningful trip to the exhibition.
The unemotional voice echoes in the quiet exhibition hall, adding a bit more eerie to the already spooky atmosphere.
After a long pause, Hella slowly speaks to EMP next to her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did you understand what she was saying?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Of course...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Not.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I don't know what those crap-isms are, but "a large flow of visitors"? Is she serious? I don't see a single soul here. Is this AI broken?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who knows? Isn't this museum known as the most wicked place in Eastside? And that radio program said... no one who went in could come out? I'd say they were probably exaggerating, though.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Yeah, the story is too corny, right? A show like DeadLover Radio should at least think of something new. How can they scare people with that...
Hahaha...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...AHHH!!!
A sorrowful laugh sounds, fluttering close but then falling silent, leaving only shivers on the back of their necks.
Hella turns around and swings her pipe in the air.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: WHO is it! Who's playing tricks on us there?! Come out and face me! Only a coward would sneak around!
She suddenly pauses and stares forward in disbelief.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The glass... is put back...
EMP looks back and freezes. The window that was broken looks brand new, and even the shards on the ground have disappeared.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: How... How is this possible?!
She rushes to the window, grabs a small statue, and throws it. The statue breaks into pieces, but the glass doesn't even crack.
Confused, she reaches out to touch it...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: <size=40>Ah!!!</size>
Countless dark palms slap on the glass, and the palm prints make her hair stand on end!
She withdraws her hand lightning fast and stumbles several steps backward before regaining her footing.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: W-w-w-what are those?! They must be friendly hands here to welcome us... They are not gonna attack us, are they?!
As if in response to her words, the hands actually pass through the glass and stretch their slender fingers toward the two.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! Did you have to jinx it?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I didn't mean it! Ah...! These things are too creepy. Stay away!! I have trypophobia!!!
